dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped rings on the posterior lateral flank exhibit thin, high-contrast dark perimeters. These structures show a rapid gradient shift from a dark exterior boundary to a light interior. Perimeter edges are characterized by irregular, slightly jagged micro-geometries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of small, solid light-intensity clusters lacking internal rings is present on the anterior neck and lower ventral region. These blobs display uniform pixel intensity and lack the dark-to-light gradient seen in the dorsal-lateral annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Connecting the centroids of the four largest annuli on the posterior flank results in an irregular quadrilateral. The internal angle between the two most dorsal annuli and the primary lateral annulus is obtuse, approximately 120 degrees.
